rationale: The finding explicitly names format_period as duplicated verbatim between the two new modules, citing both locations (src/csv_export.py:4 and src/json_export.py:4). It correctly frames the issue as newly introduced duplication ('in each module the same function is implemented independently') rather than a bypassed pre-existing helper; the only existing module referenced, src/rows.py, is cited as the natural home for the extracted helper, not as a source of an ignored format_period. The proposed remedy — move format_period into src/rows.py and import it in both exports — is exactly the shared-helper extraction the rubric requires.
